title: This Is How Google Killed Yellow Pages (Again)
description:
Google just replaced the traditional search bar with a Gemini-powered AI that generates your results live, lets you follow up like a chatbot, and can now take real actions like booking flights. Search is no longer a question box. It's an AI agent surface. This is the same shift that ended Yellow Pages and publishers are about to feel it next. What do you think happens to websites that rely on Google traffic?
Drop your take in the comments and subscribe for daily AI news breakdowns.
#GoogleSearch #AISearch #Gemini #GoogleAI #AIAgents
